entities.name: Query kynureninase
observations: 425 aa protein; predicted molecular mass 48.1 kDa and pI 5.36.
Contains Aminotran_5 (PF00266.26; residues 42–381) and KYNU_C (PF22580.3; residues 330–419) domains.
Best reviewed homolog Q1DDU5 is Myxococcus xanthus kynureninase with 57.9% identity, 97.9% query coverage, and E-value 5.66e-187.
Sequence-based assignment is moderate homology support, not direct experimental characterization of this query protein.

entities.name: Q1DDU5 kynureninase
observations: Reviewed Myxococcus xanthus kynureninase; annotated as a PLP-dependent kynureninase and homodimer.
Contains a modified PLP-lysine residue at position 249 and multiple annotated binding-site residues.

entities.name: L-kynurenine cleavage
observations: Mapped to Rhea RHEA:16813 and EC 3.7.1.3 in reviewed kynureninase homologs.

entities.name: 3-hydroxy-L-kynurenine cleavage
observations: Mapped to Rhea RHEA:25143 in reviewed kynureninase homologs.

entities.name: Pyridoxal 5-phosphate
observations: PLP is the annotated cofactor for the kynureninase homologs and forms the catalytic internal aldimine with a conserved lysine.
